scope: Independent whole-object semantic review of frozen N05 B02-B04 proposals only. This is not final153 cross-unit identity acceptance, source/producer approval, runtime/native acceptance, or full BIZQ-01 acceptance.
fingerprintSerialization: Per-item current/predecessor whole-object fingerprints use SHA-256 of compact JSON.stringify(parsed item) in insertion order. These are review fingerprints, not production canonicalJson hashes.

unitFindings.objective: Builder patterns, staged construction, and validation
unitFindings.identityAction: PRESERVE_QUESTION_ID for all17: the predecessor unit decision and the replacement remain the decision to use staged construction when required inputs/dependencies must be assembled and validated before use. The prompts make the case-specific trigger visible; this review found no primary-decision change requiring a reserved ID.

unitFindings.objective: Prototype, copy, clone, and deep-versus-shallow semantics
unitFindings.identityAction: PRESERVE_QUESTION_ID for all17: each proposal still tests explicit copy depth/identity semantics, the predecessor unit decision. The i017 key needs a wording correction to match the stated shared immutable rule-set.

PRESERVE_QUESTION_ID for all17: each item still tests the predecessor adapter/facade boundary decision with a now-visible concrete mismatch or repeated workflow. Similar practice pairs are not treated as an automatic uniqueness failure.

nonBlockingSimilarityNotes: B04 i004/i010 both practice translating interval conventions, but i004 states the configured-zone whole-day conversion while i010 combines PlotId translation with the inclusive-end contract; the current cases remain distinguishable.
B04 i006/i014 both practice preserving distinct three-state mappings, but their separate external and internal vocabularies support transfer practice.

B04 i007/i013 both exercise facade coordination, but their actual work and completion conditions differ (checksum-verified board export versus archive upload returning a location). No universal unique-concept or vignette quota is imposed.
